title: I'm making an RPG where you prompt your own items
author: W0RKABLE
selftext:
It's free and multiplayer, if you think it's interesting, please give it a try.  
I'm also looking for all the feedback I can get :)

replies.author: stormblaz
replies.body: Add a stamina counter, I feel idle after it runs out and clicking fight does nothing or battle, a countdown like the chest is needed.

replies.author: W0RKABLE
replies.body: That's a good point, will definitely add that

comments.author: SanFranLocal
comments.body:
Put all the gear on an actual sprite and give the characters animations. I’m pretty sure you can do this with nano banana. 

I’m doing something similar with my game. 
https://drawnster-battles-25895ae21edd.herokuapp.com/

replies.author: W0RKABLE
replies.body: That's unfortunately not really feasible in my game, since it's all about switching and combining gear. The gameplay is based on optimizing your loadout often and quickly. But you have a cool game, I saw it here as well :)
